Data:Acted.fraser.omen.dawn.lantern.json.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
Data:Acted.fraser.omen.dawn.lantern.json.desc: Fraser Strathcoyne decided, with some regret, that the events in Messana had nothing to do with his own recurring dreams of eyes...

Data:Acted.fraser.project.solar.lantern..label: Acted: Strathcoyne
Data:Acted.fraser.project.solar.lantern..desc: The procurement committee of the Royal Endeavour was, it seems, one of Fraser Strathcoyne's many clients. And so he came to Hush House to research their requests. 'Battleships; aerostats; locomotives. What do all these things have in common, Librarian? I'll tell you: names.'

Data:Acted.fraser.rising.scale.json.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
Data:Acted.fraser.rising.scale.json.desc: Fraser Strathcoyne came to Brancrug to interpret an oracle given by the Rising While; and became certain that he was descended from the Scimafectra-kind of the Carapace Cross; the 'Glory-Winged' ones.

Data:Acted.fraser.rite.awakening.scale.j.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
Data:Acted.fraser.rite.awakening.scale.j.desc: Fraser Strathcoyne declared his intention to drown the sandalwood image from the Strasbourg church, hoping it would 'develop further'.

Data:Acted.hokobald.heist.forge.json.label: Acted: Hokobald
Data:Acted.hokobald.heist.forge.json.desc: Magister Hokobald, employed by Oriflamme's to make improvements to their vault, thought he might have have found useful information at Hush House... although he was careful to point out that it wasn't very useful.

Data:Acted.hokobald.opera.apollo.grail.j.label: Acted: Hokobald
Data:Acted.hokobald.opera.apollo.grail.j.desc: After visiting Hush House, Magister Hokobald believed he had determined the most suitable gifts for the performers. He almost thanked me for it.

Data:Acted.hokobald.opera.wings.grail.js.label: Acted: Hokobald
Data:Acted.hokobald.opera.wings.grail.js.desc: After visiting Hush House, Magister Hokobald felt prepared to take 'full advantage' of the upcoming operatic disaster. Though he didn't seem especially grateful.

Data:Acted.hokobald.project.ingenious.fo.label: Acted: Hokobald
Data:Acted.hokobald.project.ingenious.fo.desc: Magister Hokobald planned to 'salvage' Zidane's work when it was (as he hoped) sold for scrap.

Data:Acted.hokobald.project.solar.forge..label: Acted: Hokobald
Data:Acted.hokobald.project.solar.forge..desc: Magister Hokobald came to Hush House to learn what he could of the Royal Endeavour's aims and nature. He seemed satisfied with the Endeavour; he seemed almost satisfied with Hush House.

Data:Acted.hokobald.revolution.grail.jso.label: Acted: Hokobald
Data:Acted.hokobald.revolution.grail.jso.desc: Hokobald found what he needed on 'genealogy, or cuisine, or related subjects', though he was not forthcoming about the connection these matters might have with to the revolution in the Bounds.

Data:Acted.julian.numa.moon.a.moon.json.label: Acted: Coseley
Data:Acted.julian.numa.moon.a.moon.json.desc: '...Ys, the exception, but no exception to Eternity can last forever. That's rather the point! Only when I accepted that...'

Data:Acted.julian.numa.moon.b.moon.json.label: Acted: Coseley
Data:Acted.julian.numa.moon.b.moon.json.desc: '...my arrogance, fought to overthrow Necessity. I will not say my time was wasted - no blow struck against tyranny is wasted. But only when I saw...'

Data:Acted.julian.numa.winter.a.winter.j.label: Acted: Coseley
Data:Acted.julian.numa.winter.a.winter.j.desc: '...endings like the pale light before a pale dawn. We can always be certain of a first time - we can never be certain when it is the last...'

Data:Acted.morgen.observe.scaly.sky.json.label: Acted: Morgen
Data:Acted.morgen.observe.scaly.sky.json.desc: Mlle Matutine, armed with knowledge, travelled West to see the business for herself; and warned that something might also come to the clouds above Brancrug.

Data:Acted.morgen.opera.apollo.grail.jso.label: Acted: Morgen
Data:Acted.morgen.opera.apollo.grail.jso.desc: Mlle Matutine was confident she would be the best-dressed woman in the audience.

Data:Acted.morgen.opera.apollo.sky.json.label: Acted: Morgen
Data:Acted.morgen.opera.apollo.sky.json.desc: Mlle Matutine was confident she would be the best-dressed woman in the audience... even though she had decided on a departure from her usual style.

Data:Acted.morgen.opera.wings.grail.json.label: Acted: Morgen
Data:Acted.morgen.opera.wings.grail.json.desc: Mlle Matutine went to Venice ready for a 'catastrophe' at the opera's opening. She mused that 'Earth is thicker than blood' - hinting, perhaps, at some involvement with the line of Antaios?'

Data:Acted.morgen.project.ingenious.sky..label: Acted: Morgen
Data:Acted.morgen.project.ingenious.sky..desc: Mlle Matutine hoped to complete Zidane's work; and at Hush House, or so she believed, she found what she needed to do so.

Data:Acted.morgen.revolution.grail.json.label: Acted: Morgen
Data:Acted.morgen.revolution.grail.json.desc: Mlle Matutine was certain she'd find the meal she sought, among the battles in the Bounds.

Data:Acted.olympe.heist.forge.json.label: Acted: Olympe
Data:Acted.olympe.heist.forge.json.desc: Mme Bechet thought she'd identified oddities in Oriflamme's account of their security measures... and what she found at Hush House encouraged her to look into the matter further.

Data:Acted.olympe.lost.find.moth.json.label: Acted: Olympe
Data:Acted.olympe.lost.find.moth.json.desc: Mme Bechet had no intention of going all the way to Miah... but after researching the matter at the House, she remembered an associate who might go there on her behalf.

Data:Acted.olympe.opera.wings.moth.json.label: Acted: Olympe
Data:Acted.olympe.opera.wings.moth.json.desc: Mme Bechet hoped to help a friend complete, or at least survive, the performance. At Hush House, she found something that she hoped might help.

Data:Acted.olympe.project.ingenious.forg.label: Acted: Olympe
Data:Acted.olympe.project.ingenious.forg.desc: At Hush House, Mme Bechet learnt enough (she hoped) to persuade a wealthy patroness to purchase the Unfinished Lark, and save it from being sold for scrap by the authorities.

Data:Acted.olympe.project.solar.forge.js.label: Acted: Olympe
Data:Acted.olympe.project.solar.forge.js.desc: After her visit to Hush House, Mme Bechet came to believe that the Royal Endeavour was associated with the Second Dawn... which, she opined, she would prefer to a war.

Data:Acted.rowena.numa.grail.a.grail.jso.label: Acted: Rowena
Data:Acted.rowena.numa.grail.a.grail.jso.desc: 'If I were here, this would comfort me; if I were here, I would reward you better than now I do.'

Data:Acted.rowena.numa.grail.b.grail.jso.label: Acted: Rowena
Data:Acted.rowena.numa.grail.b.grail.jso.desc: 'If I were here… perhaps it is the Twins that would have brought me. It is the Twins who unite what must not be apart. And so I share their patronage with my sisters-in-blood. As Bancroft used to say, there are other appetites than love.'

Data:Acted.rowena.numa.winter.a.winter.j.label: Acted: Rowena
Data:Acted.rowena.numa.winter.a.winter.j.desc: 'When I was here - when I came here, the first time - I was so angry. That I had been cast aside after I opened the way - that was the least of it. That I had opened the way - that was the worst of it. Though, once, I thought it was the other way around.'

Data:Acted.rowena.numa.wood.grail.json.label: Acted: Rowena
Data:Acted.rowena.numa.wood.grail.json.desc: 'When I was here - the first time - the first sacrifice I made was to the Grail. Without that, there would be no Hush House at all. Oh, the covenant-stone, the tree, all that, perhaps. But remember that it all begins with birth.'

Data:Acted.serena.heist.forge.json.label: Acted: Serena
Data:Acted.serena.heist.forge.json.desc: Dr Blackwood suspected that someone at Oriflamme's had invented the story of the heist themselves. She couldn't imagine why - but she learnt enough from me to be taken seriously by her contact there.

Data:Acted.serena.mystical.lantern.json.label: Acted: Serena
Data:Acted.serena.mystical.lantern.json.desc: Dr Blackwood dismissed the whole business of cults as a popular delusion in a time of change.

Data:Acted.serena.omen.dawn.lantern.json.label: Acted: Serena
Data:Acted.serena.omen.dawn.lantern.json.desc: After her visit to Brancrug, Dr Blackwood strongly suspected that the cause of the Messana business was not a Name of the Watchman... but a Name of the Chandler.

Data:Acted.serena.project.ingenious.forg.label: Acted: Serena
Data:Acted.serena.project.ingenious.forg.desc: Whatever Dr Blackwood found at Hush House, it convinced her that Zidane had used 'Ys-metal' in his work.

Data:Acted.serena.project.solar.forge.js.label: Acted: Serena
Data:Acted.serena.project.solar.forge.js.desc: Dr Blackwood was concerned that the Royal Endeavour might be, in some sense, the rebirth of the 'alchemies of the House of Lancaster'... perhaps even a return, in some sense, to the days of the Sovereigns of the Leashed Flame.

Data:Acted.serena.project.solar.lantern..label: Acted: Serena
Data:Acted.serena.project.solar.lantern..desc: Dr Blackwood was convinced that the Royal Endeavour was fundamentally a matter of light... but that it might be connected to the paradoxical, menacing Hour known as the Chandler.

Data:Acted.stanislav.curse.heart.json.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
Data:Acted.stanislav.curse.heart.json.desc: Father Schaller set off for the Grove of Green Immortals with a 'restless waxwork' - after finding what he needed at Hush House, to keep the thing contained on the journey.

Data:Acted.stanislav.pan.heart.json.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
Data:Acted.stanislav.pan.heart.json.desc: Father Schaller resolved to speak to some of the patrons of the Lyterion, hoping to understand a change 'in the tempo of the world's pulse.'

Data:Acted.stanislav.pan.nectar.json.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
Data:Acted.stanislav.pan.nectar.json.desc: Father Schaller resolved to visit the Black Forest, sensing an opportunity for something old to be reborn - 'in the right way or the wrong one.'

Data:Acted.stanislav.rite.awakening.nect.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
Data:Acted.stanislav.rite.awakening.nect.desc: Father Schaller declared his intention to bury the image called the 'Sandalwood Saint', hoping it might grow... but only slowly, and in the right season.

Data:Acted.stanislav.rite.renewal.nectar.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
Data:Acted.stanislav.rite.renewal.nectar.desc: Father Schaller came to Hush House to investigate the possibility that the rite was a Haustorium trap... and mentioned, perhaps only in passing, that he had managed Teresa Galmier's 'reincorporation'.

Data:Acted.stanislav.wound.heart.json.label: Acted: Father Stanislav
Data:Acted.stanislav.wound.heart.json.desc: Father Schaller, who had once been a friend of the Open Reverend, felt that he had learnt enough to give him 'what he might want.'
